entities.name: Query ribose-phosphate pyrophosphokinase
observations: 338 aa sequence; calculated molecular mass 36.68 kDa and pI 5.92.
Strong homology to reviewed ribose-phosphate pyrophosphokinases Q8YN97, Q59988, and Q55848: 79.2–84.0% identity with 97.6–98.2% query coverage.
Sequence contains Pfam matches Pribosyltran_N (PF13793), Pribosyltran (PF00156), and Pribosyl_synth (PF14572), consistent with the ribose-phosphate pyrophosphokinase family.
Best-supported function is ribose-phosphate diphosphokinase activity, EC 2.7.6.1; exact organism and experimental substrate specificity are not established from the sequence alone.

entities.name: Q8YN97
observations: Reviewed Nostoc sp. ribose-phosphate pyrophosphokinase; EC 2.7.6.1.
Catalyzes transfer of pyrophosphoryl group from ATP to the 1-hydroxyl of ribose-5-phosphate to form PRPP and AMP.
Binds two Mg2+ ions per subunit and is annotated as a cytoplasmic homohexamer.

entities.name: RHEA:15609
observations: Reaction is the pyrophosphoryl-transfer step that produces PRPP for nucleotide and other biosynthetic pathways.

entities.name: Magnesium cofactor
observations: Reviewed homologs are annotated to bind two Mg2+ ions per subunit; Mg2+ is expected to coordinate ATP/phosphate groups during catalysis.
